name: profit via use

phase_0.boundary_condition: The closed profit extraction loop bounded by maker fee capture and self-verifying closure on each trade cycle

VINIT.chosen_element: Uninitialized trading state before any signal is coupled
VINIT.justification: Represents the void before cross-domain signal coupling begins, the empty register awaiting the first market pulse

TANCH.chosen_element: The terminal profit boundary that contains the entire extraction mechanism
TANCH.justification: Acts as the closed boundary that contains the whole system, the point at which profit is realized and the cycle self-verifies

AFWD.chosen_element: Forward morphism toward profit realization via limit order flow
AFWD.justification: Directed transformation toward the target of maker fee capture, the ascent through the trade cycle

AREV.chosen_element: Reverse morphism descending through activation barrier lowering
AREV.justification: Contravariant descent transformation, the catalytic stabilization that lowers barriers without permanent structural change

CLINK.chosen_element: Sequential chaining of signal coupling to position management to cycle closure
CLINK.justification: Composition that chains morphisms in sequence, linking the dialetheic position management to the Frobenius-closed trade cycle

IMSCRIB.chosen_element: Self-referential profit verification on each cycle
IMSCRIB.justification: Identity element that self-recognizes, the stone that knows itself, ensuring each cycle closes with self-verifying closure

FSPLIT.chosen_element: Dialetheic position management splitting into Belnap B/T/F states
FSPLIT.justification: Co-multiplication that branches one position into simultaneous true, false, and both states, reflecting the paraconsistent truth lattice

FFUSE.chosen_element: Reconstitution of position from Belnap states back to unified trade signal
FFUSE.justification: Multiplication that reunites the B/T/F branches to recover the original position input exactly, satisfying FFUSE(FSPLIT(x)) = x

EVALT.chosen_element: Affirmative profit state in the T-branch
EVALT.justification: True/affirmative branch representing successful signal coupling and profit extraction

EVALF.chosen_element: Negative loss state in the F-branch
EVALF.justification: False/negative branch representing failed signal coupling or unprofitable position

ENGAGR.chosen_element: Paradice state holding both profit and loss simultaneously
ENGAGR.justification: Both simultaneously held without resolution, the bicameral compromise where contradictory positions coexist

IFIX.chosen_element: Permanent record of realized profit on the measurement record
IFIX.justification: ROM fixation that is append-only and irreversible, the permanent profit extraction record

phase_3.false_description: 10 — negative loss state, failed signal coupling or unprofitable position taken
phase_3.both_description: 11 — paradice state, both profit and loss simultaneously held without resolution in the Belnap B-state

banked_count_check.verdict: 4 unit(s) of weight cleared with nothing banked behind them: the count was in the open when the reversal came
banked_count_check.remedy: open the region that holds the result BEFORE the region that computes it, and close them in that order, so the inner fuse folds into the enclosing frame rather than into the register
